evidence.title: CyrusOne and Eolian Partner to Enable Rapid Deployment of 200 Megawatt Data Center Campus in Fort Worth, Texas
evidence.excerpt: CyrusOne's January 2026 release identifies DFW7 as a new data-center campus currently under construction in Fort Worth, Texas, after an April 2025 groundbreaking.
